evaluationShortlist.rationale: Current baseline retained as comparator plus all runtime-sustainable safety/correctness/verdict-latency nondominated DEVELOPMENT configurations. No scalar safety margin.

evidenceCommit.resolution: Evidence-only commit containing this result; SHA returned after push.

decoderProvenance.executionVersion: PyPI 0.0.6 source, not an unverified claim that master and wheel are byte-identical
decoderProvenance.eventTime: inputWindowStartMs + (frame + float32(interpolated shift))*10ms; upstream onset-only projection; frame threshold governs duration, not onset proposal creation
decoderProvenance.parity: Executable fixture compared to installed pinned Python method: pitch/frame exact, shift abs delta<1e-6; CURRENT also compared directly against TS decodeByteDanceRawOutputs.
decoderProvenance.nonfiniteShiftPolicy: Fail that decoder variant; no approximate timing substitution.

hybrid.pairing: Same-pitch maximum cardinality/minimum timing error/stable index ties within 20ms; CURRENT timestamp and min confidence; unmatched proposals discarded.

resamplers.bandLimited: scipy.signal.resample_poly, up=160/down=441, Kaiser beta=5.0, default FIR length 20*max(up,down)+1, float32 computation, constant-zero outside extended real +/-1s source; crop exact 28s
resamplers.linear: extract_resample_linear: np.linspace endpoint=False, exactly 448000 float32 samples
resamplers.mixing: float32(int16/32768) -> float64 channel arithmetic mean -> float32

geometries.inputRule: inputWindowEnd=ownedEnd+future; inputWindowStart=inputWindowEnd-1820; final partial shifted using real samples only

verdictPolicy.correct: All group slots irreversibly MATCHED; unrelated extras do not change CORRECT.
verdictPolicy.incomplete: After deadline, partial multi-pitch match with no incompatible wrong explanation.
verdictPolicy.missing: After deadline, zero matches and zero wrong explanations.
verdictPolicy.wrong: Incompatible residual observations matched to missing slots with global maximum-cardinality/min-total-temporal-error deterministic flow; takes precedence over incomplete/missing.
verdictPolicy.extra: Ledger residual after every legal expected/wrong claim is closed; no dual ownership.
verdictPolicy.wrongWindow: Group minimum expected time +/-250ms; event no later than group max expected time+250ms, pitch incompatible with all expected group pitches.
verdictPolicy.conflictFinality: Same-pitch ledger conflict components preserved; wrong-association overlapping-window components close before assignment. Conservative delay is measured, not bypassed.
verdictPolicy.naturalCompletion: After full common acoustic scope is covered, close naturally at its inclusive frontier; no future out-of-scope score claims.
verdictPolicy.latency: Measured acoustic publication availability drives deterministic causal replay; UI/perceptual latency not claimed.

protocol.counterfactualConstruction: Physical positive-velocity non-drum piano MIDI21..108; zero additional alignment. <=20ms onset groups without duplicate pitch. Full interior physical expected background. First up to8 metadata/MIDI-valid anchors per family/clip from [1500,26500). Missing/incomplete absent pitch chosen lowest60..108 with no physical same pitch within250ms. Wrong semitone +1 guarded similarly. Extra removes one physical expected slot. Retrigger requires same pitch within500ms. Sustain requires >=700ms without physical same-pitch reattack. Reject oracle-ambiguous scenarios independent of candidate output. Fixed BPM120, fractional beat positions; no score following.
protocol.coveragePolicy: Target >=20 scenarios/family across all ten clips; inadequate coverage => INSUFFICIENT_PRODUCT_VERDICT_COVERAGE and inconclusive disposition.
protocol.developmentSelection: StageA safety/correctness componentwise Pareto; geometry carries only those decoder/resampler pairs. Shortlist retains current baseline plus all sustainable safety/correctness/five-class-P95 nondominated configurations. No post-hoc non-inferiority margin.

statistics.method: Frozen xorshift32 paired whole-clip bootstrap; scenario-level paired differences retained, not treated as independent replicates.

protocol.runtimePolicy: Causal independent producer, serialized model consumer; measured per-window queue and actual session.run timing; historical480ms reserve diagnostic separate from feedback latency.

supersedes.reason: Docker downstream truth-gate receipt path normalization only; no model/decoder/projector/scoring/selection change. Five DEVELOPMENT LINEAR acoustic streams sealed; no MIDI opened by failed invocation; no EVALUATION inference.

baselineDevelopment.latencyDefinition: Targeted correctly-classified verdicts; missing/incorrect classifications counted in correctness, not silently assigned zero latency. All background/incorrect verdict latency is also retained.

knownLimitations: Counterfactual expectations on real performances are not a natural pianist-error corpus.
Five DEVELOPMENT and five EVALUATION clips are the statistical units; individual strikes are not independent replicates.
Finalization availability is causal replay of measured acoustic publications and immutable ledger deadlines, not measured native UI rendering or human feedback perception.
Shared raw-output persistence/IPC and decoder work are included in service timing; not a production-optimized harness.
All-pitch wrong-association components and same-pitch ledger conflict components can defer feedback; no early-finalization shortcut was added.
UPSTREAM_STYLE is a verified onset-time projection, not a claim of complete upstream note duration/pedal parity.
Projector compute duration is not instrumented in logical replay timestamps; these values are not full end-to-end feedback latency.
336/12189 timed starts precede nominal readiness by up to0.835205ms; timer/clock quantization is a plausible interpretation, not a separately instrumented cause. Raw offsets retained.
Variant order is fixed and not thermally counterbalanced; no hardware-cause claim or population safety guarantee.
Target verdict agreement and conditional latency are not all-background group accuracy; raw counts and complete consumption audits remain available.
